quest.title: Shrine Maiden for a Day
quest.description: According to Miko's "suggestion," you work as shrine maidens at the shrine...

chapter.num: Hangout Event: Kuki Shinobu - Act I
chapter.title: The Gang's Daily Deeds

talks.objective: Go to the entrance to receive guests
Collect materials required to make omamori

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Granny, here's the new omamori we made!

dialogues.speaker: Asami
dialogues.text: Alright, thank you, Miss.

dialogues.speaker: Asami
dialogues.text: I remember you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, Shinobu, so you...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Be quiet.

talks.objective: Collect materials required to make omamori
Collect materials required to make omamori

dialogues.speaker: Maki
dialogues.text: You need paper slips for omamori blessings? I have a few right here.

dialogues.speaker: Maki
dialogues.text: Oh, but I'm afraid I don't have a pen...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I got it.

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: This way, Ma'am. Mind the steps...

dialogues.speaker: Asami
dialogues.text: Oh, thank you so much for all your help...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Hey, Ms. Shrine Maiden, we'd like some omamori!

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Huh? You've got none left?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Guess we've gotta make our own, then...

dialogues.speaker: Maki
dialogues.text: I hope your omamori will bring our visitors good luck.

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: I pray that the Electro Archon will bless that lady and her granddaughter...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I wanted to ask — does she have vision problems?

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: Oh, you noticed? Yes, she can't see very well. We always get a little worried for her safety every time she comes up the mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: But she always refuses our offers to help. She insists that she knows the route like the back of her hand after walking it so many times in her life...

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: Luckily, there are shrine maidens along the way who can at least keep an eye on her.

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: May the Electro Archon watch over her and her granddaughter on their respective journeys...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: What's that? You want to open it now?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Hmm, well, if something bad happens, don't expect me to pick up the pieces.
